detail: From the independent verification of SP-043 (2026-11-12), all low: (1) a GitHub search through curl with org: in the URL query (api.github.com/search/code?q=org:X) is not read and not opaque, so it is allowed even in strict; (2) in strict, gh repo list and gh search for the session own org, and git push to a non-GitHub remote, are refused as opaque_strict; (3) for a named remote, pushurl is judged on fetch as well as url (over-inclusive, not a bypass). See also RC-114.
